description: Answers whether manifest, ledger, checkpoint, replay, and lineage state are trustworthy enough to allow replay/resume for the selected pipeline/run_type/time range. Primary question: Can we trust manifest/ledger/checkpoint/lineage state and safely replay/resume? GLOBAL read-path panels are not pipeline-scoped and must not use $pipeline or $run_type filtering. Control Plane Explorer (Dashboard 2.0): first screen decomposes Trust into readiness, blocker-facing cards, and missing-telemetry confidence without opening accordions.

panels.title: Monitor Telemetry Coverage
Inspect Replay & Checkpoint Evidence

options.content:
Coverage contract
- Replay duplicate/overwrite risk is covered by bounded `risk_type` telemetry.
- Manifest-to-ledger referential integrity is covered by complementary `consistent` / `inconsistent` ratio series.
- A zero blocker verdict is trustworthy only while the telemetry-coverage card is complete.

panels.title: Review Coverage Limits
panels.description: Lists replay-safety conditions that this dashboard cannot fully prove. An empty blocker count is trustworthy only within the observed telemetry coverage.

Counts replay write risk, manifest/ledger integrity, checkpoint, manifest, ledger, drift, and lineage blockers during the selected time range. Zero means no blocker evidence was recorded; verify telemetry coverage before treating it as safe. Measured 0 requires present series; No data means metric/series absence and must not be treated as healthy zero.

targets.expr:
round(((
 (sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_manifest_writes_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", status="failed"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_control_plane_ledger_appends_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="failed"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_checkpoint_compatibility_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", disposition=~".*_incompatible"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_replay_reconstructability_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", status="not_reconstructable"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_replay_drift_events_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_replay_duplicate_overwrite_risk_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type"}[$__range])))
+
 (sum(max_over_time(bioetl_manifest_ledger_integrity_ratio{pipeline=~"$pipeline", run_type=~"$run_type", integrity_type="inconsistent"}[$__range]) > bool 0))
+
 (sum(increase(bioetl_lineage_refs_missing_total{pipeline=~"$pipeline"}[$__range]))))))
